name: Jaroslav Novák
bio:
Jaroslav Novák's journey into motorsport was unconventional. Starting as a technician at a Škoda factory, his keen eye for detail and innovative solutions quickly caught the attention of rally team engineers. He transitioned to supporting their testing programs, developing data analysis techniques that improved vehicle setup. This led to a role coordinating test programs for a small European open-wheel series before Mercedes-AMG recognized his talent.

As a test driver coordinator, Jaroslav focuses on optimizing testing schedules to maximize data acquisition. He emphasizes driver feedback and rigorous analysis, combining established processes with experimental strategies. Jaroslav is known for his ability to identify subtle nuances in vehicle performance, translating driver impressions into actionable engineering tasks. His approach is defined by a relentless pursuit of improvement and a commitment to data-driven decision-making, constantly seeking innovative ways to refine testing methodologies.

Jaroslav is recognized within Mercedes-AMG for being able to extract valuable insights from limited testing opportunities and his ability to foster a collaborative environment between drivers, engineers, and technicians. He believes that communication and a shared understanding of objectives are essential for successful test programs.

physical.description: A man of medium height, Jaroslav carries himself with a quiet confidence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even to meetings.
Insists on having the same type of herbal tea every afternoon at 3 PM.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
